issues.description: The UML and problem statement specify that Animal.name is of type String, but the solution's Animal class declares the name attribute as a StringBuilder. This is a structural type mismatch for a core attribute (name) and may confuse students comparing their implementations to the reference solution or when inspecting the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Animal.name use type String to match the UML and problem description (e.g., private String name; initialize in the constructor and return/set String in getter/setter), or update the problem statement/UML to explicitly allow StringBuilder if that was intended. Prefer using String for the name attribute to avoid student confusion.
